summary: The change does what was asked, and all six criteria are met. docs/system-facts.md has a new 'Crate reach' bullet. It names the Cargo.toml files as its source and has one line per workspace crate giving its target type and the athena crates it depends on, normal and dev-only. I checked all 12 lines against the manifests by hand and they match. There is a new budgets.rs drift test that compares those lines with the manifests. It rejects an edited line, a missing line, an unknown crate, a repeated line and a badly formed line. Athena's run with the fix reverted shows the new tests fail without it. READING_RULES has a ninth line, 'Test placement', marked '(prose only)', and the rule count and section-size tests were updated. I ran the budgets tests, the system-facts tests and the reader-brief tests and they passed. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and full test runs passed. The diff touches only listed deliverables and nothing under records/ or governance files. The failure-class merge was left out as requested, because it lives in records/. There are two minor wording problems. First, 'Only `cli` has a binary' is literally false, since xtask is a binary. Second, telling readers to test xtask 'in xtask/tests/' doesn't say those tests can only run the binary, not import xtask code. Neither blocks a pass.
